supersedes: research-v2-learner-0.2 (the ppo section of configs/research_v2/default.json, gamma 1.0)
evaluation_unchanged: Dglobal, the five costs and all physical metrics stay undiscounted; gamma only changes the PPO training objective.
rationale: Under gamma 1.0 with ~1,000-decision episodes PPO did not learn consistently (pilot ablation: 0/6 seeds better than always-local, collapse to single actions). gamma 0.97 improved all 6 pilot seeds (mean D 0.443 -> 0.250) with no collapse; the bracket 1.0/0.99/0.98/0.97/0.95 gave 0.443/0.376/0.266/0.250/0.293. Entropy, rollout size and learning rate did not help.
selected_on: pilot namespace only (pilot_train outer 100-102 x repeat 0/1, 20 pilot_validation traces); no confirmatory seed (outer 0-19), no search validation split, no test trace
selection_status: exploratory diagnosis; chosen before any v0.3 gate or confirmatory run
schema_note: The v0.2 config schema fixes ppo.gamma = 1.0; v0.3 keeps the simulation config (and every trace hash) unchanged and applies the learner override only through this file.
